# Spell integration rules — provisional v0.1

Use this document with the [shared class rules](CLASS_PLAYTEST_RULES.md), the class's own engine and the [spell packet](SPELL_PLAYTEST_STARTER.md). This is a staged development layer, not an approved-book replacement or a live companion update.

## What owns each decision

| Decision | Source used for this packet |
|---|---|
| Spell identity, every school placement and per-class rank/access | Preserved `src/data/spells.js`; do not collapse different class ranks into one global rank. |
| Common RP prices and additional spell evidence | Core Systems Known Descent V2. Its spell blocks are retained with the catalog summaries. |
| Class identity, engine, spellbook/preparation and cadence exceptions | The current class playtest packet. |
| Generic Dissonance/Refrain, action limits and core conditions | Shared class playtest rules; source Core conditions remain unchanged. |
| Missing targeting, exact endpoints, concentration ambiguities and exploit limits | Explicitly provisional decisions on each spell card. |

The approved Core V2 source has 936 spell blocks. The companion catalog has 848 unique IDs representing the same number of school placements, but leaves four metadata fields unspecified. These are different views of the source, not evidence that all casting details were absent. Core's generic “Automatic or opposed as described” does not supply a concrete save or targeting rule.

Eleven possible renamed entries remain comparative evidence in the register. For example, Harmonic Bulwark's catalog summary says 5 temporary HP per RP while the possible historical Mana Shield entry says 2. It remains blocked for this packet until that conflict receives an individual decision. No name-only merge silently changes the effect.

## Select a spell

1. Choose the class through which you are learning/casting it. Check that class's school access and minimum **class** level on the card.
2. Use that class's spell rank and Core V2 cost. A different eligible class may receive the same spell at a different rank and level.
3. Record it in your allowed known, prepared or spellbook choices. An eligible catalog entry is not an automatic grant. Wizard and Druid keep their explicit preparation systems; fallback counts apply only where the class has no more specific rule.
4. Select only a spell marked `operational-playtest-draft` in this packet, or an operational spell expressly supplied by a class card. Other records stay visible in the unfinished queue.
5. A class card and an ordinary spell with the same name remain separate records with separate acquisition and costs. Knowing one does not grant the other. Oath spells, Matrix techniques and similar class spells use their own card.

Oracle uses RC and its Mystery/Curse system. Soldier and Warrior have no general Weave access. Dragoon first gains ordinary magic at class 3; Paladin at class 2. Sufficient RP, total character level, a class feature with the same name, or a borrowed spellbook cannot bypass a gate.

## Resolve a cast at the table

1. Verify the available Action/Bonus Action/Reaction, its exact trigger, components, targets, range and line of effect. No legal target means no activation or payment. A target in an area still needs the card's eligibility. Total cover blocks direct targeting unless expressly overridden.
2. Choose a spell from your actual repertoire. Determine its class-specific rank and RP cost: rank 0–9 costs **0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26**. Add explicitly printed extra costs; Resonance Shield adds 1 RP even when the caster receives it as a cantrip. Generic Overcast is excluded.
3. Read Dissonance **before** casting. Limit = max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, casting modifier)). At limit/limit+3/limit+6, ranked spells cost +1/+2/+3 RP. At limit+6 ordinary rank-1+ casting is blocked. Cantrips have no strain surcharge but still build Refrain. An expressly granted traumatic-casting exception pays the cost and its printed trauma; it grants neither rank nor repertoire access.
4. Pay before the attack/save. A miss, successful enemy save or countered legal cast does not refund payment. Begin concentration, ending the previous concentration effect before this spell resolves. Components and other resources are also spent as specified.
5. Spell attacks are d20 + PB + the **actual** casting ability modifier. Save DC = 8 + PB + that modifier. Use the card's exact hit/failure/success outcomes and existing damage/condition rules. No automatic cantrip scaling: read its explicit scaling field.
6. Apply ordinary Dissonance: 0 for rank 0, 1 for ranks 1–5, 2 for ranks 6–9. Consecutive casts of the same named spell add Refrain +1/+2/+3, capped at +3; first cast or a different named spell has +0. Apply the class's protected reduction, routing or vent at its printed timing. Weapon or idle turns do not reset the previous named spell/Refrain unless the class explicitly says so.
7. Record concentration, exact expiration, per-rest use, summon and companion command obligations. A second spell cannot smuggle in an extra Action, duplicate concentration or a resource reset.

Countering uses an already operational class ability or spell with explicit range, trigger, cost and rank limits. Being generally counterable does not give every caster a free Counterspell Reaction. The 72-spell starter tranche does not yet normalize every dispel/counter spell in the wider catalog.

## Components, summons and ongoing effects

**V** requires audible speech; **S** requires a free hand or a class feature expressly permitting the gesture; **F** is the class's ordinary casting focus. Core's M/F shorthand is interpreted here as the existing focus alternative. No unspecified costly or consumed material is added. These hand/focus conventions are provisional and may require equipment integration. A spell with V is blocked by an effect explicitly preventing verbal casting.

Summon stat blocks use their printed AC/HP/attack die. Where absent, saves use the owner's PB, other ability checks use +0, walking Speed is 30 feet, and there are no unstated creature immunities or extraordinary senses. Unless a card explicitly gives another bounded range, a commanded companion must be within 60 feet and able to perceive its owner. All one owner's companions share one Bonus Action command and **one damaging action total per round**. Without a command they move and Dodge. A replacement requires the full casting cost. No summon grants loot, a reusable corpse or resource-generating death trigger. Noncombat helpers cannot attack or operate combat items.

A cantrip that stabilizes restores no HP and removes no Wound. Mending cannot replace finite machine repair or refresh ammunition, charges, duration or class resources. Created tools, servants and water obey the explicit card limits; a spell does not silently pay wages, produce saleable materials or erase abstract expedition Supply.

All hard whole-Action/turn denial uses one combined **source-character/target/encounter** record across that character's spells, class features and companions. Once used, later hard-denial riders from that source fail; damage and soft riders resolve as printed. Boss immunities remain effective. Same-stat flat bonuses use the strongest; same-name dice bonuses do not stack. Apply one allowed bonus-die spell per roll in this packet unless a reviewed feature explicitly permits more. Temporary HP never add together. Copies never generate copies, class procs or resource loops.

## Recovery bridge and unresolved integration

The class suite's **Retune** formula is the active RP rule for this combined test: recover max(0, floor(maxRP/4 + 0.5) + actual casting modifier), capped at maximum, and clear Dissonance after a completed one-hour short rest. Retain the expedition rule of at most **two beneficial short rests between long rests**, and one beneficial eight-hour long rest per **24 hours**. A long rest restores RP and clears Dissonance; expedition time, supply, pressure, Wounds and rest legality still apply. Count time once, not once in each tracker. Oracle and other non-RP engines use their class-specific recovery, not this formula.

This bridge explicitly chooses the class Retune formula over the gameplay draft's quarter-pool-only RP paragraph. Both originals remain preserved. Recovery and Refrain are separate: neither rest is assumed to erase a previous-spell counter unless the class rule explicitly resets it; record that counter. Broader recovery decisions for all class resources still require the character/campaign integration pass.

## Developer verification

`tools/spell_playtest_rules.py` checks operational status, class access, level gates, known/prepared membership and the **common pricing step**. Its Dissonance result is deliberately labelled *before class interface*. The caller must apply the actual protected class cadence or vent and verify actions, components, target legality, concentration and effect resolution. This helper is not an automatic implementation of every spell or class.

Run `python tools/build_spell_playtests.py`, then `python tools/validate_spell_playtests.py`. Source accounting, metadata coverage, access boundaries and cost/reference scenarios are independently reported. A passing result does not certify the remaining catalog, all cross-class combinations, human balance or live-app readiness.

spells.scaling: None; always creates 3 duplicates.
spells.limitations: Duplicates have no Actions, HP, independent positions, attacks, bodies, cover, collision, resource triggers, or ability to intercept saving-throw effects. They cannot be deliberately targeted by you or allies to generate procs. A creature that does not rely on sight or explicitly ignores visual illusions targets you normally. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: The two Core V2 entries conflict: one gives 30-foot range and concentration up to 1 minute, while the other gives Self and Instantaneous. Because the source consistently says duplicates of yourself, this pilot uses self range and retains the coherent 1-minute concentration duration. V/S/M/F is represented as a small reflective token or existing class casting focus. Equal random selection and duplicate-hit procedure are NEW provisional mechanics.

spells.targets: One static visual illusion fitting entirely inside a 15-foot cube whose nearest point is within range
spells.resolution: The illusion appears automatically. A creature that uses an Action to scrutinize it makes an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC; on success it recognizes the image as illusory.
spells.effect: Create a static visual illusion contained within a 15-foot cube. It may depict creatures, objects, structures, surfaces, or visible phenomena, but it produces no sound, smell, heat, force, or physical substance.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: The illusion cannot move after creation, provide actual cover, bear weight, block movement or line of effect, create usable objects, deal damage, emit real light, trigger traps, or physically conceal a creature from effects that do not depend on sight. Investigation vs Spell DC is the mechanical disbelief procedure. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain. Physical passage through the image reveals its lack of substance to the interacting creature; no check is required to recognize that direct evidence. A known illusion grants no mechanical cover or blocked line of sight.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 15-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, V/S/F components, and source 15-foot-cube static illusion are retained. F is represented as an existing class casting focus. Exact Investigation disbelief and nonphysical limitations are NEW provisional illusion mechanics.

spells.targets: One creature within melee reach
spells.resolution: Make a melee spell attack against the target. On hit, deal 2d6 psychic damage. On miss, no damage.
spells.effect: Form an illusory blade and strike one nearby creature. On a hit it takes 2d6 psychic damage and experiences the convincing sensation of being stabbed.
spells.scaling: None; damage remains 2d6 at all class levels.
spells.limitations: Creates no physical wound, Bleed, piercing damage, weapon object, disarm interaction, or lasting false injury. The blade cannot be handed to another creature or used for opportunity attacks. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 explicitly says Spell attack and preserves Action, Instantaneous duration, and V/S/F components. Core range says 30 feet, but the source explicitly calls this a melee spell attack; this pilot therefore uses 5-foot melee range and records the range change as a provisional source-effect reconciliation. F is represented as an existing class casting focus.

spells.targets: Up to 5 willing falling creatures you can perceive within range
spells.duration: Until each target lands, stops falling, or 1 minute passes, whichever occurs first
spells.resolution: None; willing legal targets are affected automatically.
spells.effect: Slow each target's downward descent so it falls no more than 60 feet during each round while the spell remains on that target.
spells.scaling: None; maximum descent remains 60 feet per round and target cap remains 5.
spells.limitations: Does not grant flight, hovering, lateral movement, immunity to falling consequences, or automatic safe landing beyond whatever the existing falling rules produce from the reduced descent. A creature ceases to be affected once it lands or is no longer falling. Targets cannot be added after casting. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain. This Action spell requires targets that are still falling when your turn allows the cast; it is not a Reaction rescue after an already resolved impact. Fall damage itself remains the existing rule and is not automatically negated.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 consistently gives Action, 60-foot range, V/S/F components, and the five-creature/60-feet-per-round source effect, but lists Instantaneous duration despite a sustained descent change. This pilot uses a non-concentration duration until landing or 1 minute as a NEW bounded operational decision and deliberately does not import a Reaction casting time or automatic fall-damage immunity. F is represented as an existing class casting focus.

spells.targets: One creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: Make a spell attack against the target. On hit, deal 1d6 necrotic damage. On miss, no damage.
spells.effect: Launch a spark of necrotic energy that deals 1d6 necrotic damage on a successful spell attack.
spells.scaling: None; damage remains 1d6 at all class levels.
spells.limitations: Creates no healing, corpse effect, maximum-HP reduction, undead control, resource generation, or ongoing damage. Cantrip repeats use Refrain even though base Dissonance is 0.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are retained. Core resolution is 'Automatic or opposed as described' without an operational opposition method; spell attack is a NEW provisional resolution.

spells.targets: One creature you can perceive within range
spells.duration: Until the end of the target's next regular turn
spells.resolution: The target makes a Constitution save against your spell save DC. On failure, each weapon attack it makes before the spell ends deals 1 less damage, minimum 0. On success, no effect.
spells.effect: Inflict a brief necromantic chill that reduces the target's weapon-attack damage by 1 for one turn.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Affects only damage from weapon attacks, not spells, class techniques without weapon damage, ongoing damage, companion attacks, or environmental effects. Multiple Chill of the Crypt effects do not stack; a later failed save refreshes the duration. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S components are retained. Core lists Instantaneous duration despite an ongoing damage penalty and gives no operational opposition mechanic. Constitution save and duration through the target's next turn are NEW provisional specifications.

spells.targets: One living dying creature at 0 HP that you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None; an eligible target is stabilized automatically.
spells.effect: Stabilize the target at 0 HP so it is no longer dying under the normal Downed/death procedure.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Restores no HP, temporary HP, Wounds, resources, consciousness, missing body parts, or life to a dead creature. A stabilized creature remains at 0 HP. Cannot target a corpse. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Both source placements and Core V2 agree on Action, 30-foot range, V/S components, Instantaneous duration, and stabilization. No additional healing was added.

spells.targets: Self; checks for undead presences within 30 feet on the same plane
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Learn whether at least one undead creature or active undead presence exists within 30 feet.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Reveals presence only, not number, direction, identity, exact location, statistics, intentions, allegiance, or route. Effects explicitly blocking divination or undead detection prevent detection. It does not detect corpses that are not undead, necromantic magic without an undead presence, or creatures merely resembling undead. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, V/S components, and Instantaneous duration are retained. The information ceiling is a NEW provisional clarification preserving the source's narrow wording 'detect presence.'

spells.targets: One creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: Make a spell attack against the target. On hit, deal 3d6 necrotic damage. On miss, no damage and no healing.
spells.effect: On a hit, deal 3d6 necrotic damage. If the target is a living non-construct creature and takes actual damage, you regain HP equal to half the actual necrotic damage dealt, rounded down.
spells.scaling: None; damage remains 3d6 and healing remains half actual qualifying damage.
spells.limitations: Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, remove Wounds, trigger another Lifedraw, generate RP, or count copied/reflected/ongoing damage. Undead, constructs, summons created solely for resource farming, allies, helpless captives, corpses, and other nonliving targets provide no healing even if damaged. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S/F components are retained. Core gives no operational attack/save procedure; spell attack is NEW provisional. Source 3d6 damage and heal-half effect are preserved, with the living-target requirement added as an explicit anti-loop bounded fix.

spells.targets: One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; summons one Lesser Skeleton companion
spells.resolution: No initial roll. The skeleton's commanded melee attack uses your spell attack bonus.
spells.effect: Summon one Lesser Skeleton with AC 13, 10 HP, Speed 30 feet, saves equal to your PB, other checks +0, and one melee attack with 5-foot reach that deals 1d6 piercing damage on a hit. It acts immediately after you. While within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, it may be commanded with your Bonus Action to move and take its one attack or another basic action; without a command it may move and Dodge.
spells.scaling: None for source-specific AC, HP, and attack die; AC remains 13, HP remains 10, and damage remains 1d6.
spells.limitations: All companions you control share one Bonus Action command and one damaging companion action total per round. The skeleton has no unstated resistances, immunities, multiattack, spellcasting, loot, XP, resource generation, death trigger, corpse-proc eligibility, or free healing. It disappears at 0 HP or when concentration ends. Recasting replaces your prior Lesser Skeleton from this spell. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, and V/S/F components are retained. Source-specific AC 13, HP 10, and 1d6 melee override generic companion values. Speed, saves, checks, attack bonus, command economy, and anti-loop restrictions are NEW provisional specifications required by the shared summon interface. This pilot fixes its otherwise unspecified physical attack type as piercing.

spells.targets: Self
spells.duration: Until the temporary HP are lost or you complete a long rest
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Gain 1d4+4 temporary HP.
spells.scaling: None; remains 1d4+4 temporary HP.
spells.limitations: Temporary HP do not stack; keep the higher remaining amount. They are not healing, cannot exceed this spell's rolled amount from one cast, and cannot generate damage, healing, resource, or death-prevention triggers when lost. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, V/S/F components, and source 1d4+4 temporary HP are preserved. Core metadata gives 30-foot range, but the source says 'Gain,' indicating the caster; operational range is therefore Self as a labeled provisional source-effect reconciliation. The continuing temporary-HP lifetime is also specified because Core lists only Instantaneous casting duration.

spells.targets: One creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: The target makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On failure, it gains the CoreV2 Frightened condition toward you. At the end of each of its turns it repeats the Wisdom save, ending the spell on success. On the initial save success, no effect.
spells.effect: Cause one creature to become Frightened of you while concentration continues and its repeated saves continue to fail.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: A creature immune to Frightened is unaffected. The spell does not itself remove Actions, compel a hazardous route, force surrender, or alter beliefs. Repeat saves occur at the end of each target turn, preventing a passive lock. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, V/S/F components, and Wisdom save are retained. End-of-turn repeat saves are a NEW provisional bounded-control rule.

spells.targets: One unattended nonliving object weighing no more than 10 pounds within range
spells.resolution: None for an eligible unattended object.
spells.effect: Move the chosen object up to 30 feet to another legal unoccupied location that remains within 30 feet of you.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Cannot move an attended, worn, carried, secured, or resisting object; make attacks; activate or use combat items; wield weapons; pick locks; administer consumables; manipulate a creature internally; trigger a damaging device as an attack; or move an object through solid matter. The spell supplies only the single movement described and creates no persistent hand or helper. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are retained. The source specifies an object up to 10 lb within 30 feet but not its displacement distance; moving it up to 30 feet while remaining in range is a NEW provisional specification.

spells.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Choose Strength or Dexterity when cast. Before the target makes its next ability check using the chosen ability during the duration, it may consume the spell to add +1 to that check.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Must be cast before the check is rolled. Choice of Strength or Dexterity is fixed on cast. Applies to one ability check only, not an attack roll or saving throw. Multiple Minor Enhancement effects do not stack; a new cast replaces the previous one on that creature. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S components are retained. Core lists Instantaneous duration while the source modifies a future check; the 1-minute-or-consumed duration and before-roll consumption procedure are NEW provisional mechanics.

spells.targets: One nonliving mundane object within range containing one accessible break, tear, split seam, cracked joint, or separated mundane connection no larger than 1 foot across
spells.resolution: None if the damage is within the listed repair scope.
spells.effect: Repair one minor physical break or tear, rejoining the affected mundane material enough for ordinary noncombat function if all required pieces are present.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Does not restore device or construct HP, charges, ammunition, spell uses, limited resources, duration, destroyed mechanisms, magical properties, consumed materials, missing pieces, valuable raw materials, structural buildings, armor/weapon combat durability beyond the cosmetic or mundane joint repaired, or an object reduced to total destruction. It cannot manufacture a new object or repeatedly create saleable material. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are retained. The 1-foot minor-repair scope and explicit distinction from device HP/resources are NEW provisional bounded-repair rules required for integration.

spells.targets: One Small-or-smaller ordinary natural plant, patch of harmless vegetation, or similarly minor natural feature within range
spells.duration: Instantaneous; the harmless natural change then persists normally until ordinary conditions alter it
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Cause one minor non-damaging natural effect comparable in scale to making flowers bloom, leaves open or close, grass briefly bend, seeds sprout visibly without maturing, or a small patch of ordinary vegetation change harmlessly in appearance.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Cannot deal damage, restrain creatures, create difficult terrain, produce food or potable water, accelerate a crop to harvest, create valuable herbs, rare reagents, timber, poison, medicine, commodities, permanent supernatural plants, or free crafting materials. It does not replace a survival, farming, or crafting procedure. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are retained. The source only specifies minor natural effects such as blooming flowers; the operational scale and anti-commodity limits are NEW provisional boundaries.

spells.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: The target gains +2 AC. Each of its movement Speeds is halved for the duration, rounding fractions down under the shared rules.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Multiple Stoneflesh effects do not stack; a new cast refreshes duration. The AC bonus is a spell bonus and follows ordinary same-stat stacking rules. The spell grants no damage resistance, stone immunity, extra weight, natural weapon, or protection from petrification unless another rule says so. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, 1-minute duration, V/S/F components, and the source +2 AC/halved movement are retained. No concentration requirement is added because Core metadata does not specify one.

spells.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: The target can use its normal walking Speed to move across vertical surfaces and ceilings while keeping hands free, provided the surface can physically support it.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Does not grant flight, hovering, immunity to falling, movement through surfaces, automatic Stealth, or protection from hazardous surfaces. If concentration ends while the target is unsupported on a wall or ceiling, ordinary falling rules apply. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, and V/S/F components are retained. The exact use of normal walking Speed and falling consequence are NEW provisional operational clarifications.

spells.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Increase the target's walking Speed by 10 feet for 1 hour.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Multiple Longstrider effects do not stack; a later cast refreshes duration. Does not grant a new movement mode, increase flight/swim/climb unless those modes explicitly use walking Speed, or increase overland travel beyond what the campaign travel procedure allows. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 10-foot range, 1-hour duration, V/S/F components, and source +10-foot Speed are retained without added concentration.

spells.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Triple the target's normal horizontal and vertical jump distances for the duration.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Jumping still consumes movement under the normal movement rules and requires a legal landing space. The spell does not grant flight, hovering, automatic success on checks required by hazardous jumps, immunity to falling, or movement through obstacles. Multiple Jump effects do not stack. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, 1-minute duration, V/S/F components, and source triple-jump effect are retained. No concentration requirement is added.

spells.targets: One unoccupied point you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Create one floating orb of harmless visible light at the chosen fixed point. It illuminates a 20-foot radius sufficiently for ordinary visual perception.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: You may have only one Mage Light orb active at a time; recasting ends the previous one. The orb is stationary after creation, creates no heat or damage, cannot blind, reveal invisibility by itself, ignite objects, trigger solar/light vulnerabilities unless they explicitly react to ordinary light, or serve as a physical object. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, 1-hour duration, and V/S components are retained. The source gives no illumination radius or movement procedure; a fixed 20-foot illumination radius and one-orb cap are NEW provisional mechanics.

spells.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Before the target makes an ability check during the duration, it may choose to consume Guidance before rolling and add 1d4 to that single ability check.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Must be present before the roll and consumed before the d20 is rolled. Applies to one ability check only, not an attack roll, saving throw, damage roll, initiative roll unless initiative is explicitly treated as an ability check by the campaign rules, or another Guidance roll. Multiple Guidance effects do not stack. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S components are retained. Core lists Instantaneous duration despite modifying a future check; the one-minute-or-consumed duration and before-roll timing are NEW provisional operational rules.

spells.targets: One creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Transmit one whispered spoken message of up to 25 words directly to the target so only it clearly hears the magical whisper.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: The spell does not grant a reply, language comprehension, mind reading, command authority, guaranteed identity verification, communication through total cover or an effect explicitly blocking magical communication, or transmission across planes. The target hears the actual words used and may respond only through ordinary means. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 120-foot range, Instantaneous duration, and V/S components are retained. The 25-word cap, direct-hearing procedure, and no-reply boundary are NEW provisional mechanics because the source only says to whisper to a creature within 120 feet.

spells.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Before the target makes a saving throw during the duration, it may choose to consume Resistance before rolling and add 1d4 to that single saving throw.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Must be active before the save and consumed before the d20 is rolled. Applies to one saving throw only and grants no resistance to damage despite the spell's name. Multiple Resistance effects do not stack. It cannot be added after seeing the saving-throw result. Cantrip repeats use Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S components are retained. Core lists Instantaneous duration despite modifying a future save; the one-minute-or-consumed duration and before-roll timing are NEW provisional operational rules.

spells.targets: One nonliving door, lid, gate, chest, container, hatch, or comparable closable object you can perceive within range
spells.resolution: None on casting. A creature attempting to force or manipulate the secured closure without your permission makes a Strength or appropriate tool check against your spell save DC.
spells.effect: Magically secure the target closure for 8 hours. You may designate up to 3 creatures when casting that can open or close it normally. Other creatures must succeed on the required check to open it; a successful check suppresses the lock long enough for that opening but does not end the spell.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Does not make the object indestructible, repair it, increase its HP, prevent teleportation through unrelated magic, seal an open passage without a closable object, create a new physical lock, or protect against effects that explicitly dispel or bypass magical wards. One object cannot benefit from multiple Arcane Locks from the same caster. Source placements disagree on rank/RP; those are derived externally and not resolved here.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 consistently gives Action, 30-foot range, V/S/F components, and an Instantaneous metadata duration, while the source requires an ongoing magical lock. An 8-hour duration, authorized-creature list, and force/tool check against Spell DC are NEW provisional mechanics. The three source rank placements remain preserved externally.

spells.targets: One fixed 10-foot-radius ground area centered on a point you can perceive within range; choose up to 3 creatures when cast that will not trigger it
spells.duration: 8 hours or until you cast Alarm again
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Ward the chosen area against intrusion. The first time each round a Tiny-or-larger creature not excluded when cast enters the area, the spell produces a brief magical alarm audible to you and creatures within 60 feet of the ward.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: Only one Alarm from this spell may be active for you at a time; recasting ends the previous Alarm. It reports entry only, not identity, intent, alignment, statistics, exact route, or concealed facts. A creature already inside when the spell is cast does not trigger it until it leaves and re-enters. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S/F components are retained. Core says Instantaneous while the source requires a continuing alarm; 8-hour duration, 10-foot radius, exclusion list, audible trigger, and one-active-alarm cap are NEW provisional specifications.

spells.targets: One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; creates one invisible noncombat helper force
spells.resolution: None.
spells.effect: Create an invisible force that can move at Speed 30 feet and perform simple mundane tasks you could direct an unskilled helper to perform, such as carrying up to 10 pounds, opening an unlocked door, fetching an unattended object, sweeping, cleaning, arranging mundane items, holding a light object, or operating a simple harmless mechanism. It obeys simple instructions while within 60 feet and able to receive your verbal directions. Giving or changing an instruction in combat uses your Bonus Action and shares the companion command budget; it performs at most one simple noncombat object interaction on that turn. It cannot make attacks or grant the Help action.
spells.scaling: None.
spells.limitations: The servant is not a combat creature and cannot attack, deal damage, impose conditions, provide flanking, make skill checks requiring proficiency or judgment, use weapons, traps, bombs, poisons, healing items, spell items, or other combat consumables, activate class abilities, cast spells, create commodities, perform paid labor that generates free wages or economic output, craft valuable goods, carry creatures, trigger resource/death effects, or serve as physical cover. It cannot manipulate attended objects against resistance. You may maintain only one Unseen Servant at a time. It has no corporeal HP or body and cannot intercept damage; it can be ended by an effect explicitly dispelling or suppressing the sustaining spell. Recasting replaces it and pays the full RP cost.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, and V/S/F components are retained. Core lists Instantaneous duration despite creating an ongoing helper. One-hour duration, Speed 30, 10-pound carrying limit, 60-foot command range, and explicit noncombat-helper boundaries are NEW provisional mechanics. A combat command costs the shared Bonus Action; one harmless interaction per command prevents unpriced parallel combat activity.

spells.targets: One unoccupied space you can perceive within range; summons one Small spirit familiar
spells.resolution: No initial roll. The familiar's commanded attack uses your spell attack bonus.
spells.effect: Summon one Small spirit familiar using the shared standard companion profile: AC 12+floor(PB/2), HP equal to 2 times your class level, Speed 30 feet, saves equal to your PB, other checks +0, and one melee or ranged attack with 5-foot reach or 30-foot range using your spell attack bonus and dealing S d6 damage of bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage (choose one type and melee or ranged mode on casting; keep them fixed for that summon). It acts immediately after you. While within 60 feet and able to perceive your command, your Bonus Action can command it to move and make its one attack or take another basic action; without a command it may move and Dodge.
spells.scaling: Uses the shared companion profile: AC increases with PB, HP equals 2×class level, and attack damage is S d6 at class levels 1/5/11/17.
spells.limitations: All companions you own share one Bonus Action command and one damaging companion action total per round. The familiar gains no unstated flight, invisibility, telepathy, special senses, resistances, immunities, spell delivery, independent spellcasting, Help-based automatic advantage, loot, wages, corpse, resource generation, death trigger, or free resummon benefit. It disappears at 0 HP or when concentration ends. Recasting replaces your prior familiar from this spell. Ranked casting causes normal Dissonance and Refrain.
spells.designNotes: Core V2 Action, 30-foot range, concentration up to 1 minute, and V/S/F components are retained. The source provides no specific familiar statistics, so the existing shared standard-companion profile is used rather than importing another game's familiar block. Command range/perception and anti-loop limits follow the current playtest companion interface.
